survivability.conditional_edge: p(side | script) - break_even, break_even = executable ask + Kalshi fee per contract
survivability.counter_case: material script with the most negative share x edge contribution
survivability.edge_concentration: largest positive share x edge contribution / sum of positive contributions
survivability.edge_ex_top_script: (overall edge - top contribution) / (1 - top script share)
labels: SCRIPT_DEPENDENT: at most one supporting material script, or edge concentration >= 0.75 in a script with share < 0.25 and edge_ex_top_script <= 0
survivability.stance: SUPPORTS if conditional edge >= +band; OPPOSES if <= -band; NEUTRAL otherwise; IMMATERIAL below the material share
survivability.weighted_support_share: sum of SUPPORTS material shares / sum of material shares
